issues.quote: انتساب انحصاری مسئولیت کنش‌ها به یک هستار
issues.explanation: The 'توضیح کوتاه' cell for پاسخگویی (3.1.1) renders the definition as an unqualified absolute ('انتساب انحصاری') but the printed definition in T23728-3.1.1 is «میزانی که مسئولیت کنش‌های یک هستار را می‌توان منحصراً به آن هستار نسبت داد» — accountability is expressed as a degree or measure ('میزانی که ... می‌توان'), not as a fait accompli exclusive assignment. Dropping 'میزانی که می‌توان' converts a qualified, graded concept into an absolute claim not found in the cited evidence.
issues.suggested_fix: Revise the brief-description cell to «میزان انتساب انحصاری مسئولیت کنش‌های یک هستار به آن هستار» to preserve the 'degree/extent' sense, or at minimum add the qualifier: «(به میزانی که قابل انتساب است)».

issues.quote: پنج بند هنجاری این‌گونه خلاصه شده‌اند
issues.explanation: No cited evidence item labels sections 5–9 as 'هنجاری' (normative). Evidence S23728-028 describes them simply as 'بندهای ۵ تا ۹' without any normative designation. The only explicit labeling in the source index marks Annex A as '(آگاهی‌دهنده)' (informative), which supports inferring by default that main body clauses are normative, but that inference is not stated in any cited item and therefore cannot be asserted as if it were printed in the standard.
issues.suggested_fix: Change 'پنج بند هنجاری' to 'بندهای ۵ تا ۹' or 'پنج بند اصلی استاندارد'. If normative status must be stated, add an editorial footnote (marked as compiler's note) explaining that sections 5–9 are normative by default, given that only Annex A is explicitly labeled informative in the printed standard.
